comments.author: Zezima
comments.body:
Question: I want to put 2 of the same part to increase minimal improvement limit even if I get failure but how the game calculates the results?

The game calculate both FS parts separately even if both increases the same stat or does the game calculate both separately as individual parts?

I mean, do I get failure-success-great success for each part as indivual fs parts?

Example 1 / case 1 (as individual FS parts succes)

Improvement material slots:

FS Part one: +1 ~ +3 WR, you get succes (+2WR)
FS Part two: +1 ~ +3 WR, you get great succes (+3WR)

Improvement limits:
+2 ~ +6 WR
Possible results:
+2 WR, +3 WR, + 4 WR, +5 WR + 6 WR
You get (in this case)
+5 WR

or do I get same failure-succes-great success for both parts at same time?

Example 2 / case 2 (as one FS part succes)

FS Part one: +1 ~ +3 WR
FS Part two: +1 ~ +3 WR

Improvement limits:
+2 ~ +6 WR
Possible results:
+2 WR, +4 WR, +6 WR
You get (in this case)
Failure: +2 WR

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
It's based on the waves in the waters your sailing in (if you dont know how to check that, it's the wave icon in the lower right corner of the screen). If you have a WR equal to, or above that number, you should good against high waves. Galleys are usually meant to be sailed along coasts and inland seas, and not out on the high seas, hence their low WR count.

Getting an aide with Breakwater helps curtail this as well.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
What BlakeC said is correct about the WR.

You're immune to any broadside and high waves disaster when it is equal to the sea waves or higher.

Important thing to note is that broadside disaster happens regardless the direction you sail and high waves ONLY if you sail closer than 90˚ against the waves. The disaster of high waves (leaking) drops the durability of your figurehead and special equipment so be careful not to sail either with low dura of them.

DPiano than you had probably lucky or you had an aide with WR prevention or a shipskill to counter that.
